# PR Research Agent

> A private Digital PR, SEO, and AEO research tool. It analyzes published articles, finds editorial opportunities, scores them for search and answer-engine fit, researches writers and content/SEO contacts, and writes personalized pitches for human review. It never sends email.

## What this tool does

- Analyzes a published article for credible PR angles and evidence.
- Finds real articles and editorial openings for a chosen angle.
- Scores each opportunity for intent fit, authority, brand contribution, AEO opportunity, contactability, and risk.
- Finds the bylined writer, content manager, SEO lead, or link-building contact.
- Writes a 120–180 word pitch with a subject line, facts to verify, and one low-pressure next step.
- Exports sites, contacts, and drafts to CSV.

## Skill

- [SEO / AEO / Digital PR skill](/skills/seo-aeo-digital-pr.md): the full methodology, scoring rubric, AEO checklist, contact rules, and output contract.

## API

Base URL: `https://pr.prachiadmane.com`

`POST /api/analyze` with a JSON body. Actions:

- `analyze` — `{article_url}`
- `opportunities` — `{angle}`
- `journalists` — `{angle, opportunity}`; falls back to a verified content/SEO contact when no writer matches.
- `draft` — `{angle, opportunity, person}`
- `listicles` — `{search_theme, related_queries, target_audience, target_market, competitors, max_results}`
- `listicle-contact` — `{item}`
- `publisher-policy` — `{item}`

The API is token-gated. It is not an open endpoint.

## Rules

- Only use emails explicitly published on public pages.
- Never guess an email pattern or use scraped-email sites.
- Never invent statistics, citations, contacts, policies, or coverage.
- Paid, sponsored, affiliate, and directory routes are labeled honestly.
- A human reviews every contact and every draft. The tool does not send.

## Machine-readable notes

- Opportunity verdict: `Strong fit`, `Possible fit`, `Weak fit`, or `Not suitable`.
- AEO fields: audience question, concise answer, evidence, schema or format, page section.
- Preferred output: stable JSON fields plus a short human-readable summary.
